_comment: CrazyGames technical limits, each tied to the official page it was read from.
Read by scripts/crazygames-audit.mjs. Not a Factory profile and not vendored from one: the
pinned profile (core/reference/platforms/crazygames.yaml@1.0.0) carries only the 250 MB total
and none of the initial-download, file-count or relative-path rules, so the audit cannot rely
on it alone. Discrepancies with the profile are listed in
docs/platforms/crazygames/requirements.md so they can be fed back to the Factory.
CrazyGames does not version its documentation. `retrieved` is the date the page was read; a
limit is re-checked by re-reading `source`, and `retrieved` is updated only when that happens.
MB is not defined on the source pages. Byte values use 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes, the smaller
of the two readings, so an ambiguous build fails here rather than at the portal.

total_size_bytes.text: A maximum total file size of 250MB is allowed.

total_size_without_sdk_bytes.text: In case the SDK is not integrated, total file size is used and thus should be ≤ 50MB.

file_count.text: There's a file count limit on 1500 files as high file counts will make loading slower.

initial_download_bytes.text: The game must have an initial download size ≤ 50MB. ... measured between the start of loading and the occurence of the first Gameplay start event.

initial_download_mobile_homepage_bytes.text: In order to be eligible for the mobile homepage, the initial download size needs to be ≤ 20MB.

time_to_gameplay_external_s.text: For externally hosted/loaded files our QA team will evaluate based on the time it takes to reach gameplay (≤ 20 seconds).

relative_paths_only.text: Use only relative paths when referring to other files in the game bundle. Never use absolute paths, as they will fail to load.

data_module_bytes.text: Game data when converted to a JSON string cannot exceed 1048576 bytes.

banners_per_screen.text: A maximum of 2 in-game banners may be displayed on the same screen/view.
